microarray.readouts: genome-wide transcript expression levels; differentially expressed transcripts; gene expression signatures correlated with vaccine response

evidence_location.quote: We identified expression changes in 4740 transcripts (Dataset 1) after imposing a FDR cutoff of 0.01 on the P value for the day effect.

hemagglutination inhibition (HAI) tests.readouts: influenza antibody titers against vaccine strains

evidence_location.quote: Antibody titers were measured by both hemagglutination inhibition (HAI) and neutralization assays. The titer results from these assays were strongly correlated, and the titers generally plateaued after day 14.
